{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Emph","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"seven"}]}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Div","c":[["",[],[]],[{"t":"BlockQuote","c":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"},{"t":"Emph","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"x"},{"t":"Strong","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"y"},{"t":"Span","c":[["",[],[]],[{"t":"Str","c":"z"}]]}]},{"t":"Str","c":"w"}]}]},{"t":"Div","c":[["",[],[]],[{"t":"Plain","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"two"}]}]]}]},{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"three"}]}]]},{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Note","c":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Emph","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"four"}]}]},{"t":"BlockQuote","c":[{"t":"Plain","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"five"}]}]}]},{"t":"Str","c":"six"}]}]}
@@@ filter walk-typewise-nil-all walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}
local MODE = 'nil'
local function note(s) LOG[#LOG + 1] = s end
local function id(el)
  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t
end
local function element(name, kind)
  return function(el)
    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return el, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local L = {traverse = 'typewise'}
L.Cite = element('Cite', 'inline')
L.Code = element('Code', 'inline')
L.Emph = element('Emph', 'inline')
L.Image = element('Image', 'inline')
L.LineBreak = element('LineBreak', 'inline')
L.Link = element('Link', 'inline')
L.Math = element('Math', 'inline')
L.Note = element('Note', 'inline')
L.Quoted = element('Quoted', 'inline')
L.RawInline = element('RawInline', 'inline')
L.SmallCaps = element('SmallCaps', 'inline')
L.SoftBreak = element('SoftBreak', 'inline')
L.Space = element('Space', 'inline')
L.Span = element('Span', 'inline')
L.Str = element('Str', 'inline')
L.Strikeout = element('Strikeout', 'inline')
L.Strong = element('Strong', 'inline')
L.Subscript = element('Subscript', 'inline')
L.Superscript = element('Superscript', 'inline')
L.Underline = element('Underline', 'inline')
L.BlockQuote = element('BlockQuote', 'block')
L.BulletList = element('BulletList', 'block')
L.CodeBlock = element('CodeBlock', 'block')
L.DefinitionList = element('DefinitionList', 'block')
L.Div = element('Div', 'block')
L.Figure = element('Figure', 'block')
L.Header = element('Header', 'block')
L.HorizontalRule = element('HorizontalRule', 'block')
L.LineBlock = element('LineBlock', 'block')
L.OrderedList = element('OrderedList', 'block')
L.Para = element('Para', 'block')
L.Plain = element('Plain', 'block')
L.RawBlock = element('RawBlock', 'block')
L.Table = element('Table', 'block')
L.Inline = element('Inline', 'inline')
L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')
L.Meta = function(m) note('Meta')
  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
return {L, {Pandoc = save}}

@@@ filter walk-topdown-nil-base walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}
local MODE = 'nil'
local function note(s) LOG[#LOG + 1] = s end
local function id(el)
  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t
end
local function element(name, kind)
  return function(el)
    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return el, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local L = {traverse = 'topdown'}
L.Inline = element('Inline', 'inline')
L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')
L.Meta = function(m) note('Meta')
  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
return {L, {Pandoc = save}}

L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')
L.Meta = function(m) note('Meta')
  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
return {L, {Pandoc = save}}
@@@ filter walk-topdown-nilstop-mix walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}
local MODE = 'nilstop'
local function note(s) LOG[#LOG + 1] = s end
local function id(el)
  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t
end
local function element(name, kind)
  return function(el)
    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return el, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end

L.Str = element('Str', 'inline')

L.Block = element('Block', 'block')

  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

  return doc
end
return {L, {Pandoc = save}}

local LOG = {}

    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return el, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end

local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local L = {traverse = 'topdown'}
L.Cite = element('Cite', 'inline')
L.Code = element('Code', 'inline')
L.Emph = element('Emph', 'inline')
L.Image = element('Image', 'inline')
L.LineBreak = element('LineBreak', 'inline')
L.Link = element('Link', 'inline')
L.Math = element('Math', 'inline')
L.Note = element('Note', 'inline')
L.Quoted = element('Quoted', 'inline')
L.RawInline = element('RawInline', 'inline')
L.SmallCaps = element('SmallCaps', 'inline')
L.SoftBreak = element('SoftBreak', 'inline')
L.Space = element('Space', 'inline')
L.Span = element('Span', 'inline')
L.Str = element('Str', 'inline')
L.Strikeout = element('Strikeout', 'inline')
L.Strong = element('Strong', 'inline')
L.Subscript = element('Subscript', 'inline')
L.Superscript = element('Superscript', 'inline')
L.Underline = element('Underline', 'inline')
L.BlockQuote = element('BlockQuote', 'block')
L.BulletList = element('BulletList', 'block')

L.DefinitionList = element('DefinitionList', 'block')

L.Plain = element('Plain', 'block')
L.RawBlock = element('RawBlock', 'block')
L.Table = element('Table', 'block')
L.Inline = element('Inline', 'inline')
L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')
L.Meta = function(m) note('Meta')
  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
function Pandoc(doc)
doc = doc:walk(L)
return save(doc)
end

@@@ filter walk-method-inline-topdown-same walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}
local MODE = 'same'
local function note(s) LOG[#LOG + 1] = s end
local function id(el)
  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t
end
local function element(name, kind)
  return function(el)
    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return el, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local L = {traverse = 'topdown'}
L.Cite = element('Cite', 'inline')
L.Code = element('Code', 'inline')
L.Emph = element('Emph', 'inline')
L.Image = element('Image', 'inline')
L.LineBreak = element('LineBreak', 'inline')
L.Link = element('Link', 'inline')
L.Math = element('Math', 'inline')
L.Note = element('Note', 'inline')

L.Space = element('Space', 'inline')
L.Span = element('Span', 'inline')
L.Str = element('Str', 'inline')
L.Strikeout = element('Strikeout', 'inline')

L.Underline = element('Underline', 'inline')
L.BlockQuote = element('BlockQuote', 'block')
L.BulletList = element('BulletList', 'block')
L.CodeBlock = element('CodeBlock', 'block')
L.DefinitionList = element('DefinitionList', 'block')
L.Div = element('Div', 'block')
L.Figure = element('Figure', 'block')
L.Header = element('Header', 'block')
L.HorizontalRule = element('HorizontalRule', 'block')
L.LineBlock = element('LineBlock', 'block')
L.OrderedList = element('OrderedList', 'block')
L.Para = element('Para', 'block')
L.Plain = element('Plain', 'block')
L.RawBlock = element('RawBlock', 'block')
L.Table = element('Table', 'block')
L.Inline = element('Inline', 'inline')
L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
function Pandoc(doc)
for _, b in ipairs(doc.blocks) do
  if b.t == 'Para' or b.t == 'Plain' or b.t == 'Header' then
    for i, x in ipairs(b.content) do b.content[i] = x:walk(L) end
  end
end
return save(doc)
end
@@@ filter walk-method-doc-topdown-list walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}
local MODE = 'list'
local function note(s) LOG[#LOG + 1] = s end
local function id(el)
  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t
end
local function element(name, kind)
  return function(el)
    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return el, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local L = {traverse = 'topdown'}
L.Cite = element('Cite', 'inline')
L.Code = element('Code', 'inline')
L.Emph = element('Emph', 'inline')
L.Image = element('Image', 'inline')
L.LineBreak = element('LineBreak', 'inline')
L.Link = element('Link', 'inline')
L.Math = element('Math', 'inline')
L.Note = element('Note', 'inline')
L.Quoted = element('Quoted', 'inline')
L.RawInline = element('RawInline', 'inline')
L.SmallCaps = element('SmallCaps', 'inline')
L.SoftBreak = element('SoftBreak', 'inline')
L.Space = element('Space', 'inline')
L.Span = element('Span', 'inline')
L.Str = element('Str', 'inline')
L.Strikeout = element('Strikeout', 'inline')
L.Strong = element('Strong', 'inline')
L.Subscript = element('Subscript', 'inline')
L.Superscript = element('Superscript', 'inline')
L.Underline = element('Underline', 'inline')
L.BlockQuote = element('BlockQuote', 'block')
L.BulletList = element('BulletList', 'block')
L.CodeBlock = element('CodeBlock', 'block')
L.DefinitionList = element('DefinitionList', 'block')
L.Div = element('Div', 'block')
L.Figure = element('Figure', 'block')
L.Header = element('Header', 'block')
L.HorizontalRule = element('HorizontalRule', 'block')
L.LineBlock = element('LineBlock', 'block')
L.OrderedList = element('OrderedList', 'block')
L.Para = element('Para', 'block')
L.Plain = element('Plain', 'block')
L.RawBlock = element('RawBlock', 'block')
L.Table = element('Table', 'block')
L.Inline = element('Inline', 'inline')
L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')
L.Meta = function(m) note('Meta')
  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
function Pandoc(doc)
doc = doc:walk(L)
return save(doc)
end

L.CodeBlock = element('CodeBlock', 'block')
L.DefinitionList = element('DefinitionList', 'block')
L.Div = element('Div', 'block')
L.Figure = element('Figure', 'block')
L.Header = element('Header', 'block')
L.HorizontalRule = element('HorizontalRule', 'block')
L.LineBlock = element('LineBlock', 'block')
L.OrderedList = element('OrderedList', 'block')
L.Para = element('Para', 'block')
L.Plain = element('Plain', 'block')
L.RawBlock = element('RawBlock', 'block')
L.Table = element('Table', 'block')
L.Inline = element('Inline', 'inline')
L.Block = element('Block', 'block')
L.Inlines = list('Inlines')
L.Blocks = list('Blocks')
L.Meta = function(m) note('Meta')
  if MODE == 'edit' then m.edited = true end
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return m, false end
  return m end
L.Pandoc = function(d) note('Pandoc#' .. #d.blocks)
  if MODE == 'nil' or MODE == 'empty' then return nil end
  if MODE == 'stop' then return d, false end
  return d end

local function save(doc)
  local items = {}
  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
function Pandoc(doc)
doc = doc:walk(L)
return save(doc)
end
@@@ filter walk-method-blocks-topdown-stop walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}
local MODE = 'stop'
local function note(s) LOG[#LOG + 1] = s end
local function id(el)
  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t
end
local function element(name, kind)
  return function(el)
    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))
    if MODE == 'same' then return el end
    if MODE == 'edit' then
      if el.t == 'Str' then return pandoc.Str(el.text .. '!') end
      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end
      return el
    end
    if MODE == 'list' then
      if kind == 'inline' then return {el, pandoc.Str('+')} end
      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end

    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end

    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end

end

@@@ filter walk-method-inline-topdown-stop walk-allkinds walk-deep

local LOG = {}

  if el.t == 'Str' then return 'Str:' .. el.text end
  return el.t

    note(name .. '>' .. id(el))

    if MODE == 'edit' then

      if el.t == 'Header' then el.level = el.level + 1 end

    end
    if MODE == 'list' then

      return {el, pandoc.HorizontalRule()}
    end

local function list(name)
  return function(xs)
    note(name .. '#' .. #xs)
    if MODE == 'same' or MODE == 'edit' or MODE == 'list' then return xs end
    if MODE == 'empty' then return {} end
    if MODE == 'stop' then return xs, false end
    if MODE == 'nilstop' then return nil, false end
  end
end
local L = {traverse = 'topdown'}
L.Cite = element('Cite', 'inline')
L.Code = element('Code', 'inline')
L.Emph = element('Emph', 'inline')
L.Image = element('Image', 'inline')
L.LineBreak = element('LineBreak', 'inline')
L.Link = element('Link', 'inline')
L.Math = element('Math', 'inline')
L.Note = element('Note', 'inline')
L.Quoted = element('Quoted', 'inline')
L.RawInline = element('RawInline', 'inline')
L.SmallCaps = element('SmallCaps', 'inline')
L.SoftBreak = element('SoftBreak', 'inline')
L.Space = element('Space', 'inline')
L.Span = element('Span', 'inline')
L.Str = element('Str', 'inline')
L.Strikeout = element('Strikeout', 'inline')
L.Strong = element('Strong', 'inline')
L.Subscript = element('Subscript', 'inline')
L.Superscript = element('Superscript', 'inline')
L.Underline = element('Underline', 'inline')
L.BlockQuote = element('BlockQuote', 'block')
L.BulletList = element('BulletList', 'block')
L.CodeBlock = element('CodeBlock', 'block')
L.DefinitionList = element('DefinitionList', 'block')

  for i, s in ipairs(LOG) do items[i] = pandoc.MetaString(s) end
  doc.meta.log = pandoc.MetaList(items)
  return doc
end
function Pandoc(doc)
for _, b in ipairs(doc.blocks) do
  if b.t == 'Para' or b.t == 'Plain' or b.t == 'Header' then
    for i, x in ipairs(b.content) do b.content[i] = x:walk(L) end
  end
end
return save(doc)
end
@@@ filter walk-error-inline-gives-block walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Str(s) return pandoc.Para{s} end
@@@ filter walk-error-block-gives-inline walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Para(p) return pandoc.Str'x' end
@@@ filter walk-error-inline-list-with-block walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Str(s) return {s, pandoc.Para{}} end
@@@ filter walk-error-inlines-gives-element walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Inlines(xs) return pandoc.Str'x' end
@@@ filter walk-error-blocks-gives-element walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Blocks(xs) return pandoc.Para{} end
@@@ filter walk-error-inlines-gives-strings walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Inlines(xs) return {'a', 'b'} end
@@@ filter walk-error-blocks-gives-string walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Blocks(xs) return 'text' end
@@@ filter walk-error-inline-gives-string walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Emph(e) return 'two words' end
@@@ filter walk-error-meta-gives-string walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Meta(m) return 'x' end
@@@ filter walk-error-pandoc-gives-number walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Pandoc(d) return 5 end
@@@ filter walk-error-pandoc-gives-meta walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Pandoc(d) return d.meta end
@@@ filter walk-error-not-functions walk-allkinds walk-deep
return {{Str = 5, Para = 'x', Inline = {}, traverse = 'topdown', Space = function() return pandoc.Str'_' end}}
@@@ filter walk-error-traverse-unknown walk-allkinds walk-deep
return {{traverse = 'bottomup', Str = function(s) return pandoc.Str(s.text .. '.') end}}
@@@ filter walk-error-traverse-number walk-allkinds walk-deep
return {{traverse = 7, Emph = function(e) return e.content end}}
@@@ filter walk-error-typewise-false walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Str(s) return pandoc.Str'k', false end
@@@ filter walk-error-topdown-true walk-allkinds walk-deep
return {{traverse = 'topdown', Emph = function(e) return pandoc.Strong(e.content), true end, Str = function(s) return pandoc.Str(s.text .. '?') end}}
@@@ filter walk-error-topdown-meta-stop walk-allkinds walk-deep
return {{traverse = 'topdown', Meta = function(m) m.x = true; return m, false end, Str = function(s) return pandoc.Str(s.text .. '?') end}}
@@@ filter walk-error-topdown-pandoc-stop walk-allkinds walk-deep
return {{traverse = 'topdown', Pandoc = function(d) return d, false end, Str = function(s) return pandoc.Str(s.text .. '?') end}}
@@@ filter walk-error-error-in-walk walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Pandoc(d)
  return d:walk{Str = function(s) error('stop here') end}
end
@@@ filter walk-error-inline-walk-self walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Pandoc(d)
  local e = pandoc.Emph{pandoc.Str'a'}
  d.blocks:insert(pandoc.Para{e:walk{Emph = function() return pandoc.Str'gone' end, Str = function() return pandoc.Str'b' end}})
  return d
end
@@@ filter walk-error-block-walk-self walk-allkinds walk-deep
function Pandoc(d)
  local q = pandoc.BlockQuote{pandoc.Para{'a'}}
  d.blocks:insert(q:walk{BlockQuote = function() return {} end, Para = function() return pandoc.Plain'b' end})
  return d
end
